subject: Request: short customer blurb + approval for AWS co-sell listing (Skyline Health)
messages:
From: Paul Kim <paul.kim@skylinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Testimonial for AWS co-sell badge - quick ask

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — quick one from our side. We are finalizing the AWS Marketplace co-sell listing and AWS requested a short customer quote (1-2 sentences) and permission to use our logo and a one-line beneficiary blurb for the listing. Would Redwood be able to provide a short customer quote describing the value you delivered for us (latency reduction / inference costs)? If possible, could you also confirm logo usage and send a signed approval PDF?

Examples they like:
- "Redwood Inference reduced our per-request latency by 45% and cut inference costs by 30% on peak telemetry workloads."

We need this by EOD Dec 2 to hit their co-sell intake. Happy to accept short options for us to pick from.

Thanks,
Paul
Paul Kim
Director, DevOps
Skyline Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Testimonial for AWS co-sell badge - quick ask

Thanks Paul — looping in Vanessa (Partner Lead) and Marissa (Marketplace ops) to expedite. Two quick Qs before we draft:
1) Do you want the quote to emphasize performance (latency/cost) or go broader (time-to-market / ops simplification)?
2) Any legal constraints on logo usage / brand lockups we should know about?

We can draft 2 short options and a one-line blurb for the benefits section. If Skyline legal can sign off with a brief PDF, that should be fine for AWS.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Growth, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Paul Kim <paul.kim@skylinehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Testimonial for AWS co-sell badge - quick ask

Hi Paul — thanks for the heads up. Below are two short quote options and a suggested one-line beneficiary blurb. Please let us know which you prefer or send your preferred wording and we'll prepare an approval PDF. I’ve attached our co-sell guidelines for reference.

Option A (performance focused):
"Redwood Inference reduced Skyline Health’s inference latency by ~45% and helped lower per-call costs by 30%, enabling faster real-time triage at scale."

Option B (business + ops):
"Redwood’s serving platform accelerated our ML feature delivery and reduced inference costs, giving our teams predictable latency and lower run costs."

One-line blurb for listing:
"Reduced latency and inference costs for real-time clinical workflows."

If Skyline legal needs a specific signature block, attach the signed PDF to your reply and we’ll handle the marketplace upload once we have permission.

Attachments: co-sell-guidelines.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Lead, Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference

To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800

Thanks Vanessa — Skyline legal reviewed and approved Option A with a tiny wording tweak below. Attached is the signed approval PDF and a high-res logo. Please use this final quote and blurb for the AWS listing:

Final quote (approved):
"Redwood Inference reduced Skyline Health’s inference latency by ~42% and cut per-call inference costs by 28%, enabling faster, cost-effective triage at scale."

Final one-line blurb: "Lower latency and reduced inference costs for real-time clinical triage."

Attached: Skyline_Testimonial_Signed.pdf, Skyline_Logo_HR.png
